text:
گنگ بھنگ دو بھین ہے، رہن شیوا دے سنگ۔
ہڈی کھانت گنگ ہے، لڈو کھانت بھنگ۔
romanized:
Gang bhang do bhen hai, rehan Shiva de sang.
Haḍḍī khānt Gang hai, laḍḍū khānt bhang.
literal_en:
The Ganges and bhang are two sisters, they live in company with Shiva (gods).
The Ganges consumes bones (of dead Hindus) and bhang feeds on sweetmeats.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
